name: The Starter
tradition: The Mother Dough Rising now opens every Sourdoughs home date: the game-day Dough Keeper feeds the century-old starter under the 50-yard line, the bowl counts the bubbles on the board, and the first rise tells the crowd the offense is ready to proof.

cue.label: Mother Dough Rising
cue.pregameLine: The Dough Keeper is feeding the old starter below midfield, and The Starter is counting every bubble on the board.
cue.crowdResponse: The Culture answers with a slow RISE! AND! SHINE! chant that gets louder every time the offense breaks the huddle.
